tour.label: Welcome to Onlook
tour.canvas.title: See your project live
tour.canvas.body: Each browser on the canvas is a live page of your project. You shape all of it by prompting.
tour.chat.title: Ask for a change
tour.chat.body: Describe what you want in chat, and the agent makes the change on your canvas.
tour.variations.title: Get variations
tour.variations.body: Ask for options, and new versions open on the canvas. The originals stay as they are.
tour.layouts.title: Explore, then choose
tour.layouts.body: Each layout is an experiment to try out. Pick the one you want, and the agent builds it in.
tour.riff.title: Click, then ask
tour.riff.body: Click anything on a page to select it, then ask for what you want.
tour.carousels.title: Variations of anything
tour.carousels.body: Get variations of just what you selected, side by side with the original.
tour.wrap.title: Keep exploring
tour.wrap.body: Ask for a change, a few variations, or something entirely different. When it’s right, ship it to your codebase as a pull request.
tour.scene.filtersPrompt: Make the search filters expandable on mobile
tour.scene.filtersReply: Done. The filters now open from the tune button and keep the list visible.
tour.scene.layoutsPrompt: Explore a few layouts for Home
tour.scene.layoutsReply: I opened three layouts under your pages: full bleed, editorial and grid.
tour.scene.carouselsReply: I added three carousels beside the grid: peek, stack and quotes.
